desc: 钴蓝斜切撞色罐装补剂套图，白底主图加空白参数表与空印章墙
name: 钴蓝撞色罐装营养补剂款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼夺点击，用纯背景合规主图立住罐型轮廓。
主图一秒法则：斜切撞色加三格留空参数位，把核心主张压在一屏内。
用一张留空参数表承接成分与规格疑虑，所有数值行一律空着由后期填。
用一圈留白印章框承接资质背书，具体认证字样一律不落地以消除风险。
以封口与罐口螺纹的微距做工证明密封与卫生，替掉原背标的所有文字主张。
收口促单：双罐并排暗示组合装，下方空横幅只留给优惠信息但不落任何数字。

style.backgroundSystem: alternating bright key field #FFFFFF, cool light field #F2F5F7 and one saturated brand field #0C5DA6, every frame split by a hard diagonal colour wedge edged in deep ink #101820
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight circular seal frames with two short blank bars inside, outlined in deep ink #101820 on a bright interior #FFFFFF, no filled pictograms and no real certification marks
style.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio light, frontal key with a soft fill card on the shadow side, one soft contact shadow grounding the container, no harsh speculars, macro shots lit by a single skimming light
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clinical sports-nutrition ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of a bright key field #FFFFFF, a cool light field #F2F5F7, one saturated brand field #0C5DA6 and deep ink #101820 for outlines and rules; cool studio tone held across the set; every frame split by a hard diagonal colour wedge; modern geometric sans-serif with heavy condensed display weights and hairline rules; consistent thin single-weight circular seal frames and blank label bars; bright even high-key lighting with a frontal key, soft fill card and one soft contact shadow; the wide-mouth container always upright at stable scale with its label face toward camera; all printed areas rendered as flat blank panels, empty ruled rows and empty seal frames, never as legible characters; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no legible words, digits or barcodes inside blank panels
style.presentationRules: the wide-mouth tub stays upright at stable scale with its label face toward camera across the set; angle, size and cap position must not drift between shots
style.surfaceSystem: glossy seamless studio sweep #FFFFFF and matte board #F2F5F7, container always sitting flush with a real contact shadow
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif with heavy condensed display weights and hairline rules; all printed areas are carried as blank bars and empty ruled rows, never as legible characters
